# Checkpoint

Task: add readable authentication method matching as a Rego built-in in the authz engine.

Implemented `flipt.is_auth_method` in `internal/server/authz/engine/ext`, registered it with OPA as a two-argument built-in, mapped the supported names to generated protobuf enum constants, and imported the extension from the Rego engine so it is registered at runtime. diff --git a/internal/server/authz/engine/ext/extentions.go b/internal/server/authz/engine/ext/extentions.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..2f5dcc4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/internal/server/authz/engine/ext/extentions.go
@@ -0,0 +1,64 @@
+package ext
+
+import (
+	"encoding/json"
+	"fmt"
+	"strconv"
+
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/ast"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/rego"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/types"
+	auth "go.flipt.io/flipt/rpc/flipt/auth"
+)
+
+func init() {
+	rego.RegisterBuiltin2(
+		&rego.Function{
+			Name:        "flipt.is_auth_method",
+			Description: "Reports whether the authentication method matches the supplied name.",
+			Decl:        types.NewFunction(types.Args(types.A, types.S), types.B),
+		},
+		isAuthMethod,
+	)
+}
+
+var authMethods = map[string]auth.Method{
+	"token":      auth.Method_METHOD_TOKEN,
+	"oidc":       auth.Method_METHOD_OIDC,
+	"kubernetes": auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES,
+	"k8s":        auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES,
+	"github":     auth.Method_METHOD_GITHUB,
+	"jwt":        auth.Method_METHOD_JWT,
+	"cloud":      auth.Method_METHOD_CLOUD,
+}
+
+func isAuthMethod(_ rego.BuiltinContext, input, key *ast.Term) (*ast.Term, error) {
+	name, ok := key.Value.(ast.String)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported auth method: %v", key.Value)
+	}
+
+	method, ok := authMethods[string(name)]
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported auth method: %s", string(name))
+	}
+
+	obj, ok := input.Value.(ast.Object)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no authentication found")
+	}
+
+	auth := obj.Get(ast.StringTerm("authentication"))
+	if auth == nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no authentication found")
+	}
+
+	authObj, ok := auth.Value.(ast.Object)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no authentication found")
+	}
+
+	actual := authObj.Get(ast.StringTerm("method"))
+	expected := ast.NumberTerm(json.Number(strconv.Itoa(int(method))))
+	return ast.BooleanTerm(actual != nil && actual.Value.Compare(expected.Value) == 0), nil
+}
diff --git a/internal/server/authz/engine/ext/extentions_test.go b/internal/server/authz/engine/ext/extentions_test.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..97b9295
--- /dev/null
+++ b/internal/server/authz/engine/ext/extentions_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,62 @@
+package ext
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/rego"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func TestIsAuthMethod(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		name   string
+		method int
+		want   string
+		match  bool
+	}{
+		{name: "token", method: 1, want: "token", match: true},
+		{name: "oidc", method: 2, want: "oidc", match: true},
+		{name: "kubernetes", method: 3, want: "kubernetes", match: true},
+		{name: "k8s alias", method: 3, want: "k8s", match: true},
+		{name: "github", method: 4, want: "github", match: true},
+		{name: "jwt", method: 5, want: "jwt", match: true},
+		{name: "cloud", method: 6, want: "cloud", match: true},
+		{name: "method does not match", method: 5, want: "token", match: false},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			query, err := rego.New(
+				rego.Query(`flipt.is_auth_method(input, "`+tt.want+`")`),
+				rego.Input(map[string]any{"authentication": map[string]any{"method": tt.method}}),
+			).PrepareForEval(context.Background())
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+
+			results, err := query.Eval(context.Background())
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.Len(t, results, 1)
+			require.Equal(t, tt.match, results[0].Expressions[0].Value)
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestIsAuthMethodErrors(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Run("missing authentication", func(t *testing.T) {
+		_, err := rego.New(
+			rego.Query(`flipt.is_auth_method(input, "token")`),
+			rego.Input(map[string]any{}),
+			rego.StrictBuiltinErrors(true),
+		).Eval(context.Background())
+		require.ErrorContains(t, err, "no authentication found")
+	})
+
+	t.Run("unsupported method", func(t *testing.T) {
+		_, err := rego.New(
+			rego.Query(`flipt.is_auth_method(input, "password")`),
+			rego.Input(map[string]any{"authentication": map[string]any{"method": 1}}),
+			rego.StrictBuiltinErrors(true),
+		).Eval(context.Background())
+		require.ErrorContains(t, err, "unsupported auth method: password")
+	})
+}
